AlsoOn.description: One entry of a card's `also_on`: a tagged member of its group (with `id`) or a derived link.

at.description: For a derived link, a time that belongs to it (an archived copy's capture).

derived.description: A link nobody tagged, found by a source: never fetched, counted or ranked.

oneOf.description:
The frame that shows this link (docs/api.md, Embed), as on a card: from the link itself,
else, for a tagged member, the one its own card stores. Null when there is none.

id.description: A tagged member's resource ID; absent on a derived link.

kind.description:
For a derived link, a qualifier (`archived`, `work`, `source`, `submitted`, `published`,
`pdf`), or `maybe`: a match by metadata (artist, title, length), possibly the same
thing, never by an exact ID; it joins no group.

site.description: The service: a member's site as its card names it, a derived link's service name.

via.description: For a derived link: the hub or service it came through (`musicbrainz`, `wikidata`).

Because.description: Why a `related` row is listed: the resource's taggers who also referenced it.

shared.description:
How many of the resource's sampled taggers referenced this row (with `collapse=group`,
its group's members together, each tagger once): the count the row is ranked by.

taggers.description:
Up to three of them (Pubky public keys), those who tagged the resource most recently
first. Ask Nexus for their names and tags.

Card.description:
The one card every route returns for a resource, occurrence or reference event. Absent
values are null, never "".

also_on.description:
The same thing elsewhere: the other members of its group (tagged links, with their ID),
then derived links nobody tagged (`derived: true`), by service name; one per service, and
never another link on the card's own service. Of a recording's or an album's links, the one
on the card's own release, else on the original edition (docs/api.md, Also on). At most 8
on a search, lookup or group card, 256 on a resource read. A hint: every member keeps its
own card.

attribution.description:
OpenStreetMap cards, events placed at an OSM venue and events whose zone was derived from
coordinates: the ODbL attribution to display with the card.

oneOf.description: On a `related` search row only: why it is listed, from what its rank counted.

collections.description:
How many public collection posts hold the card's link, its own or one of its aliases' (the
31 most recently collected), each once, counted up to 1,000 (`1000`: 1,000 or more); 0
when none does. The collections are
`GET /v1/resources/{id}/collections` (docs/api.md, Collections). An occurrence's are its
feed's.

credits.description:
Where `image` and `description` came from when Pinakes added them from another source
than the link itself (a MusicBrainz card's Wikipedia or Wikidata text, its Commons image,
or an album's front cover from the Cover Art Archive; a Wikidata item's card's Commons
image; a film's or series' poster or overview from TMDB): one credit per such field, with
its source page and, when it has them, its author and licence (a cover and TMDB's values
have neither: both are null), to show with the value (docs/api.md, Credits; a value
credited to `tmdb` also with TMDB's logo and notice, `/v1/info` `attributions`). At most
4; `[]` when none. A field without a credit came from the link itself.

description.description: Plain text, entity-decoded: escape it before rendering it as HTML.

oneOf.description:
The frame a client may load, sandboxed, to show the link as its own site does
(docs/api.md, Embed): a service's player, a social post, a map, slides. From the link
itself for the services Pinakes knows, else from the page's oEmbed answer or its own player
tags. Null when there is none, and on a card whose link is gone (`missing`).

episodes.description:
On a podcast show's card (`PodcastSeries`, status `ok`): its latest episodes that have a
`stream`, newest first, at most 5, each as `GET /v1/resources/{id}/episodes` lists it (its
group's list when it has none of its own: an Apple Podcasts or Spotify show grouped with
its feed). Read from the list the show's last read stored, never from the feed. Absent
on every other card and on a show without one (docs/api.md, Episodes).

oneOf.description: For a Nexus event reference: the reference this card is.

maybe_same.description:
On an event card: other events that are possibly the same one, best first (the rule:
"Possibly the same event" in docs/api.md); on an app's store card, other store cards that
are possibly the same app ("Possibly the same app"); on a MusicRecording card, other
recordings that are possibly the same one ("Possibly the same recording"). Up to three on
a search, lookup or group card and up to ten on a resource read. A hint only: never a
group, never counted, and never a member of this card's own group. Absent on other cards,
and on a kind's cards when its hint is off (`[event] same_event_hint` for events and apps,
`[groups] same_recording_hint`).

name.description: Plain text, entity-decoded: escape it before rendering it as HTML.

oneOf.description: For a calendar occurrence: which feed instance this card is.

open_in.description:
The clients that open a Pubky app's object, from the app's profile (docs/pubky-apps.md);
on an event card, those of the event object it names. Empty for every other card.

refs.description:
The links people referenced on Pubky that resolve to this card: its own `uri` and its
`aliases` that carry references (the 31 most recently referenced), most referenced first
(counted up to 1,000 each, then by URI), at most 5, normalized as every URI is. A typed
card's `uri` is often not a link anyone wrote (`btc:block/…`, `isbn:…`): ask Nexus by
these to find the tags (docs/api.md, Joining with Nexus). An occurrence's are its feed's.
A gone social post's are its own link's alone.
Empty when nothing references the card.

site.description:
The publishing site: the app for `pubky://` objects (e.g. `loopky`); the service a
link's URL names (`Apple Music`, `Wikipedia (de)`, `MusicBrainz`, `Wikidata`,
`OpenStreetMap`); else the site name the document gives, else the host. Plain text, like
every text field.

oneOf.description:
Audio a client can play with one player for every kind: a podcast episode's enclosure,
or a recording's public preview (`preview: true`). Only public, direct links, never
signed, expiring or behind a login (docs/api.md, Stream). Absent when the card has none.

type_path.description:
The type's ancestors, root first (`["Thing", "Event", "MusicEvent"]`): a search for
`type=Event` matches this card when `Event` is among them.

category.description: An OpenStreetMap category, `key/value` (`amenity/cafe`), as `category` takes it.

ChangeLine.description:
One change: which resource (and occurrence) changed, when, how and in which fields. Clients
read the current facts from the resource itself.

root.description: For an `aliased` line: the root that answers for this resource from now on.

since.description: Inclusive lower bound on the change time, as a string or as Unix milliseconds

oneOf.description: RFC 3339, Unix milliseconds as text, or relative to the request: now, now-Nd, now-Nh, now+Nd or now+Nh (the current minute); a later page keeps the first page's window

uris.description: Links, read as `POST /v1/resources/lookup` reads them; an unknown link adds nothing.

reach_truncated.description: The `reach` or `boost` set was capped at 1,000 authors.

Collection.description: A public collection post that holds the card's link.

indexed_at.description: When Nexus indexed the version that holds the link: an edit moves it up.

uri.description:
The collection post (`pubky://<author>/pub/<ns>/v1/posts/<id>`). Ask Nexus or the
homeserver for its name and items.

cursor.description: The next page's cursor; `null` on the last page.

items.description:
The viewer's own first (their 100 newest), then newest first. Can hold fewer than `limit`,
none even, while references stored before ingest kept each post at one file remain: page
on until `cursor` is `null`.

Credit.description:
Where one of the card's `image` or `description` came from when Pinakes added it from another
source than the link itself, and the licence it is used under (docs/api.md, Credits). Show it
with the value: the author, the licence (linked to `license_url`) and the source page.

author.description:
Who made it, plain text of at most 256 bytes: "Wikipedia contributors" for an article, the
file's author for an image. Null for a public-domain or CC0 file that names none, for a
Wikidata description (CC0), for a cover from the Cover Art Archive and for TMDB's values.

excerpted.description:
The text is a part of a longer source: a summary is an article's first paragraphs, and a
long one is cut at a sentence or a word. A Wikidata description is whole.

field.description: The card field the value is in.

lang.description:
The language of a text (`en`, or another Wikipedia's language code, `de`); null for an
image.

license.description:
An SPDX licence ID (`CC-BY-SA-4.0`, `CC-BY-2.0`, `CC0-1.0`, `GPL-3.0-only`,
`LGPL-2.1-or-later`), `public-domain`, or `Attribution` (Commons' licence of that name,
which has no SPDX ID). Null for a cover from the Cover Art Archive and for TMDB's poster
or overview, which carry no licence: cover art is its label's, shown as a service shows an
album's cover, and TMDB's values carry none either (`license_url` is null too).

license_url.description:
The licence's text: an `https:` URL; null when it has none (public domain, a cover from
the Cover Art Archive, TMDB's values).

modified.description: The value was changed beyond cutting it.

source_url.description:
The page the value came from: the Wikipedia article, the file's page on Commons, the
item's page on Wikidata, the cover art page of the release on MusicBrainz, or the title's
page on TMDB. An `https:` URL of at most 1,024 bytes.

subject.description:
The link of the entity the value is about, when that is not the card's own: a recording's
description taken from its work's item names the work (`https://musicbrainz.org/work/…`).

CreditField.description: The card field a credit is for.

CreditProvider.description: The service an enriched value came from.

Details.description: The fields a resource read adds to the card.

aliases.description:
Other spellings of this link that resolve to it (its aliases), by URI, at most 50. A
page's own claims (`url`, `@id`, `sameAs`, canonical links) are not aliases and are not
listed. The card's `uri` is the canonical one: an alias is answered with its root's card.
A gone social post lists none: a spelling's link can carry the post's title.

facts.description:
The fields that API names for the object, or a Pubky app profile's facts, or a
MusicBrainz page's own (`artist`, `duration` in seconds, `genre`, `disambiguation`, an
artist's `country_code`, an album's `release_type`, …; docs/api.md), then the facts the also-on
sources read for it (such as a music link's `isrc`, `upc` and `mbid`; each source's page
in docs/sources lists its own), by name; several values are joined with "; ".
`null` when there are none.

from.description:
Where the card's metadata came from when it is not the page itself: the official API
that answered (docs/sources).

keys.description:
The public identifiers this resource is keyed by, as `GET /v1/search?key=` takes them
(`isrc:…`, `upc:…`, `doi:…`, `isbn:…`, `mb:recording:…`, `wikidata:Q…`, `osm:node/…`):
the keys its sources vouch for, sorted; `[]` when there are none.

related.description:
The objects the card points at, each with its own card (docs/api.md, Related objects): a
Bitcoin transaction's block, inputs and outputs; a block's previous and next block and
coinbase transaction; an address's latest transactions; a Lightning node's biggest
channels and their peers; a channel's nodes and funding transaction. Each is
`{rel, uri, name?, amount_sat?, at?}`; `uri` is a root `POST /v1/resolve` reads, or null
for an input or output without an address (`name` says what it is). At most 10 of a
`rel`, read with the card; `[]` on every other card.

related_total.description:
How many entries of a `rel` there are when `related` lists fewer of them
(`{"input": 400}`); null when it lists them all.

Embed.description: The frame to load for a link (docs/api.md, Embed).

allow.description:
The Permissions Policy features the frame may use, for its `allow` attribute (joined with
`; `), from `accelerometer`, `autoplay`, `clipboard-write`, `encrypted-media`,
`fullscreen`, `gyroscope`, `picture-in-picture` and `web-share`.

aspect.description:
Width divided by height, for a frame that scales with its width (a video, a map, a slide
deck); null otherwise.

autoplay_param.description:
A query parameter (`autoplay=1`, `auto_play=true`) that makes the player start once
loaded: set it in `src` (replacing that parameter's value there, which is off) only when
the viewer pressed play. Null when the player has none.

height.description:
The frame's height in CSS pixels, for a frame of fixed height (a player strip, a post, a
document); null when it scales with its width (`aspect`) or the provider gives none.

provider.description:
Who serves the frame: a service Pinakes knows (`youtube`, `vimeo`, `spotify`,
`soundcloud`, `mixcloud`, `tidal`, `deezer`, `apple-music`, `apple-podcasts`, `x`,
`mastodon`, `openstreetmap`), else the oEmbed provider's name in lower case with hyphens
(`speaker-deck`), else the frame's host.

src.description:
The frame's address: `https`, on a public host name, without a credential. It never starts
playing by itself (see `autoplay_param`).

Episode.description: One of a show's latest episodes, as its feed lists it.

guid.description:
What names the item ([`item_identity`]): its GUID as the feed gives it; its page when it
gives none; else `sha256:` and the hex digest of its enclosure's URL, so a signed link
shows nothing of itself here.

id.description:
The episode's own card, when Pinakes has one for its `uri` (an alias reads as its root);
absent until someone looks it up.

name.description: Plain text, entity-decoded: escape it before rendering it as HTML.

oneOf.description:
Its enclosure, when public and direct (`Stream`); null when the item has none Pinakes
would hand to a player.

uri.description:
The episode's page (the item's link), else its feed item (`{feed}?guid={guid}`), which
resolves to its `PodcastEpisode` card.

items.description:
The show's latest episodes, newest first; empty for a resource that is no show or whose
feed was not read yet.

Facets.description: The facets `facet` asked for, over the whole filtered set.

category.description:
`facet=category`: the OpenStreetMap categories of the filtered set, most frequent
first, at most 100.

host.description:
`facet=host`: the services of the filtered set, most frequent first, at most 100.
`pubky://` objects have no service host and are not counted here.

tags.description: `facet=tags`: the labels the filtered links carry, most frequent first.

type.description: `facet=type`: the card types of the filtered set, most frequent first.

GroupDetail.description:
`GET /v1/groups/{id}`: what joined the group and every member's own card. A group is a hint
that the members are one thing on several services; nothing about them is merged.

keys.description: The identifiers two or more members share (`cite:…`, `ics_feed:…`, `ics_uid:…`).

members.description: Every member's card, by ID and then member key.

type.description: The type most members have (ties by name).

GroupRef.description:
The group this card is in (its other members are in `also_on`). Nothing is merged; every
member keeps its own card.

size.description: Members in the group, this one included.

host.description:
The host as `host` takes it: exactly as the links' URLs name it (`www.youtube.com` and
`youtube.com` are two hosts).

site.description:
The service's name as its cards show it in `site` (`YouTube`, `Wikipedia (en)`), else
the host. Plain text.

start_here.description: The usage guide: read it first.

mcp.description: The MCP endpoint; absent when `api.mcp` is off.

social_graph.description: Graph questions (who follows whom, trust, threads): nexus-scout.

Info.description:
What a client needs: the version, the User-Agent this instance sends, what it resolves, the
limits a client must respect, and the licence of the OSM-derived values its cards carry.

api_shape.description: The shape of the cards this instance returns: 2, one flat object per card (docs/api.md).

attributions.description:
What a client must show while it shows values from these services, each the
`credits[].provider` of the values it gave: the service's notice, verbatim, and its logo
(less prominent than the client's own marks). Listed while this instance uses the
service, and after, while a stored card still holds one of its values; absent when none
is.

resolves.description: The kinds of links this instance resolves: its routes and card kinds that are on.

user_agent.description:
The User-Agent this instance's requests to other services carry: its version and the
operator's contact (`http.contact`), when set.

notice.example: This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.

url.description: The service's site, to link the logo or the notice to.

change_lookup.description: Resource IDs or URIs in one `POST /v1/changes/lookup`.

collapse_refs_per_member.description: `collapse=group`: references counted per member to pick a group's row.

occurrence_lookup.description: Feed IDs or URIs in one `POST /v1/occurrences/lookup`.

previews_per_minute.description: `POST /v1/resolve` requests per minute per client address, and per URI.

related_min_shared.description: …and a row needs at least this many shared taggers (its group's, when collapsed).

related_refs_per_tagger.description: …at most this many of each tagger's references (their most recent)…

related_seed_links.description:
…on each of at most this many of its links (its group's members and their aliases), the
ones with the newest tags.

related_tag_sample.description: `related`: the taggers are drawn from the resource's most recent tags, at most this many…

related_taggers.description: `related`: the taggers sampled, the authors of the resource's most recent tags, at most this many…

related_window_days.description: …and how far back their references count without `window` (days)…

requests_per_minute.description: Requests per minute per client address, every public route together.

search_page.description: The largest `limit` of one search page.

feed_uri.description:
The feed's URI: the link people tagged. To combine with Nexus, send this, not the card's
own `uri` (the occurrence's URL, which nobody tagged).

status.description:
The instance's lifecycle: `scheduled`, `cancelled`, `postponed`, `rescheduled` or
`moved_online`. The card's own `status` is the feed's fetch health.

cursor.description: Signed keyset cursor, scoped to these feeds and window; invalid after restart.

from.description:
Inclusive start time (RFC 3339); defaults to the earliest accepted horizon start of these
feeds.

resource_ids.description:
Feed resource IDs; with `uris`, 1–500 together. An alias reads its root, an unknown ID
adds nothing.

uris.description: Feed links, read as `POST /v1/resources/lookup` reads them; an unknown link adds nothing.

items.description: One card per occurrence, with `occurrence` naming the feed instance and its lifecycle.

OpenIn.description: A client that opens an object, and the object's address there.

OsmDumpLine.description: A dump line: the notice first, then one place per line.

OsmDumpNotice.description: First line of the OSM dump: the ODbL notice.

OsmDumpPlace.description:
One cached OSM object per line after the notice; every field is present, null where unknown.
The projection is explicit (`OSM_DUMP_LINE`): internal columns never reach the dump.

versions.description:
Every derived document served publicly, keyed by the version hash that change entries
and pinned resource documents name.

dump.description: The share-alike download: the ODbL derivative database as a daily file.

updated_at.description: When the file was last written; `null` before the first.

recurrence_id.description: The instance of a recurring event; `null` for a one-off one.

Related.description:
One object a card points at (docs/api.md, Related objects): on a Bitcoin or Lightning card,
the block a transaction is in, its inputs and outputs, a block's neighbours, an address's
latest transactions, a node's channels and peers, a channel's nodes and transactions.

amount_sat.description:
In satoshis: an input's or output's value, a channel's capacity, a block's reward on its
coinbase transaction, or what a transaction moved into (positive) or out of (negative)
an address.

at.description: When it happened: the block time of a transaction or of a transaction's block.

name.description:
Plain text: a block's "Block 975,251", a node's alias, a channel's peer's alias, or the
label of an entry without a `uri`.

rel.description:
What it is to this card: `block`, `input`, `output`, `previous`, `next`, `coinbase`,
`tx`, `channel`, `peer`, `node`, `funding_tx` or `closing_tx`.

uri.description:
Its card's URI, a root `POST /v1/resolve` reads (`btc:tx/…`, `btc:address/…`,
`ln:node/…`); null for an input or output without an address, which `name` labels
(`OP_RETURN`, `coinbase`).

ResourceDetail.description:
`GET /v1/resources/{id}`, `GET /v1/resources/by-uri` and `POST /v1/resolve`: the card with
the resource's further fields, one flat object (`api_shape` 2 in `/v1/info`).

SameEvent.description:
Another event, app or recording that is possibly the same one. An event: it starts together
with this one, near it (or, when either has no place, at the same venue or under the same
organizer), under a similar name, on another page. On an app's store card: another store card
with the same website host and name (`start` is absent, `score` 1). A recording: the same title
and first artist, and a length within 3 s when both are known, on another page, with no key
that joins them.

id.description: Its card's ID (a feed's, for an occurrence).

score.description:
An event: how alike the two names are, from 0.5 to 1 (pg_trgm similarity of the normalised
names). An app: 1. A recording: 1 when both lengths are known and within 3 s, 0.7 when one
is unknown.

start.description: An event's start; absent for a recording.

uri.description:
Its page: the occurrence's own page, or the feed's or event's link (for a feed read from a
service's API, that service's page); a recording's link.

reach_truncated.description: The `reach` or `boost` set was capped at 1,000 authors.

Stream.description:
Audio a client can play: an episode's enclosure, or a recording's public preview (docs/api.md,
Stream).

type_path.description:
Where the type sits in schema.org, from `Thing` down to the type itself
(`["Thing", "CreativeWork", "MusicRecording"]`): enough to build the tree and roll
counts up into families.

info.description: Pinakes ranks, Nexus hydrates. External resource metadata and search. Every operation carries examples named by their values, covering every kind of card and source; pick one in a dropdown and use Try it out.
info.title: Pinakes

get.description: Where an agent starts: the guide, the skill, the MCP endpoint, the OpenAPI document and nexus-scout for graph questions.

200.description: The usage guide for agents: what Pinakes indexes, a quickstart, recipes, joining with Nexus, MCP, limits and errors. Its base URL is the host that served it.
The guide as an agent skill: front matter named `pinakes`, then the guide.

422.description: Body of another shape than the route takes

200.description: The ODbL derivative database, written daily, as a gzip file download. Decompressed it is one JSON object per line: the licence notice first (`OsmDumpNotice`), then one cached OSM object per line (`OsmDumpPlace`). Single byte ranges are served (206)

206.description: The requested byte range of the file

429.description: Over `limits.osm_dump_downloads_per_hour` transfers (200 or 206) to this address in the last hour; HEAD, 304 and 416 are free

503.description: No dump file written yet; retry later

get.description: The version, what this instance resolves and the limits a client must respect. The same path on admin_listen has the operator detail.

post.description: The calendar instances of several feeds in one time-ordered page: by start, then feed, UID and recurrence ID. Each card's `id` is its feed. The window and limits are those of `GET /v1/resources/{id}/occurrences`; unknown IDs add nothing.

400.description: 1–500 valid IDs, a valid window, limit or cursor

422.description: Body of another shape than the route takes

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the next attempt, when it is put off (a missing answer waiting for the fetch that confirms it); absent while the job is queued or running

400.description: Unsupported URI, disabled resolver, or a link that carries a credential

422.description: Body of another shape than the route takes

503.description: The instance's new previews for this hour are taken; nothing was stored

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a new preview can be taken

parameters.description: The link as referenced: normalised like every URI, and an alias answers with its root.
parameters.name: uri

get.summary:
One link's card by its URI, as `POST /v1/resources/lookup` answers for it: a link Pinakes
does not know is a 404 and is not fetched (`POST /v1/resolve` resolves it).

400.description: Exactly one list of 1–500 IDs or URIs

422.description: Body of another shape than the route takes

parameters.description: 32 lowercase hex resource ID
parameters.name: id

get.description: The public collection posts that hold this card's link, its own or an alias's, as Nexus indexed them: the viewer's own first when `viewer` is given (their 100 newest), then newest first. Each once, however many of the card's links it holds. A card's `collections` counts them. Private collections are never seen.

parameters.description: 32 lowercase hex resource ID
parameters.name: id

parameters.description:
A user's public key (z-base-32): that user's collections come first, their 100 newest;
any more are listed with the others.
parameters.name: viewer

parameters.description: 1–100, default 20.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description:
The page's `cursor`: signed, bound to this resource and `viewer`; invalid after a restart
(start again on HTTP 400).
parameters.name: cursor

400.description: Invalid resource ID, viewer, limit or cursor

get.description: A podcast show's latest episodes as its feed lists them, newest first: at most 20, each with its page or feed item, date and public stream. The show's own list, else, for a card that is a show, that of a member of its group which has one (an Apple Podcasts show grouped with its feed). A known resource that is no show, or no longer one, or whose feed was not read yet, returns an empty list.

parameters.description: At most this many, newest first: 1–20, default 20.
parameters.name: limit

get.description: Calendar instances ordered by start, UID and recurrence ID. Inclusive window, default limit 100, maximum 500. Superseded keys are omitted.

parameters.description: Inclusive start time; defaults to this feed's last accepted horizon start.
parameters.name: from

parameters.description: Signed keyset cursor, scoped to this resource and window; invalid after restart.
parameters.name: cursor

get.description: Examples: pick the example in the dropdown of each parameter it uses; the other parameters stay (none) and are not sent.

parameters.description:
One schema.org type, or up to 10 comma-separated: any of them (OR), each with its
subtypes (`Event` matches `MusicEvent`).
parameters.name: type

parameters.description:
Links carrying one exact identifier, on any service and in any spelling:
`mbid:{uuid}` (a MusicBrainz recording, release, release group or artist, or the MBID a
MusicBrainz page was merged from),
`wikidata:{Q-id}`, `isrc:{code}`, `upc:{barcode}`, `isbn:{ISBN-10 or ISBN-13}`,
`imdb:{tt…}` (an IMDb title), `podcast:{GUID}` (a podcast's `podcast:guid`),
`osm:{type}/{id}`, `doi:{DOI}`, `gtin:{barcode}` (a product, in any of its lengths), any
key exactly as a resource read lists it in `keys`, or another namespace a source records
(its page in docs/sources names it).
parameters.name: key

parameters.description:
Resource ID: what the people who tagged it also referenced, ranked by how many of them
did, then by the newest of those references (not with `sort`). A resource in a group
stands for the group, whose members are never listed.
parameters.name: related

parameters.description:
`following`, `friends` or `wot_2` of `viewer`: only references by authors in that set
count (a filter). `wot_2` needs a Nexus that serves the reach-set route (else 501).
parameters.name: reach

parameters.description:
`following`, `friends` or `wot_2` of `viewer`: cards that authors in that set referenced
rank higher, the more of them and the more recently they did, and nothing is left out
(with the default ranking, `sort=relevance` or `sort=trending`).
parameters.name: boost

parameters.description:
`relevance` (how well `q` matches: the name, then tag labels, then the description;
the activity score breaks ties; needs `q`), `activity`, `recent`, `distance` (needs
`near`), `start` or `trending`. Default: `relevance` when `q` is set (not with `related`),
else `activity`.
parameters.name: sort

parameters.description:
With `sort=trending` or `related`: how far back references count, `1h`–`90d` (`{n}h` or
`{n}d`), default `7d` for trending and `limits.related_window_days` for related.
parameters.name: window

parameters.description: Authenticated opaque keyset cursor from this daemon; invalid after restart. Restart pagination on HTTP 400.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description:
Counts over the whole filtered set, comma-separated, any of: `type` (card types), `tags`
(labels), `host` (services, as `host` takes them), `category` (OpenStreetMap categories,
as `category` takes them); `collapse` changes the rows, not the counts.
parameters.name: facet

parameters.description: West,south,east,north in degrees; west > east crosses the antimeridian.
parameters.name: bbox

parameters.description: Latitude,longitude in degrees; requires radius and excludes bbox.
parameters.name: near

parameters.description: Positive metres, at most the configured maximum (200000 by default).
parameters.name: radius

parameters.description:
Inclusive start time lower bound: RFC3339, Unix milliseconds, or relative to the request
(`now`, `now+7d`, `now-12h`; the current minute).
parameters.name: from

parameters.description: Inclusive start time upper bound: RFC3339, Unix milliseconds, or relative (`now+30d`).
parameters.name: to

parameters.description: Finite map zoom; fractional zooms are floored and clamped to the table. Requires bbox; large views coarsen to the configured cell budget.
parameters.name: cluster

parameters.description: Resource ID of the accepted event venue; filters event units.
parameters.name: venue

parameters.description:
A collection post's URI (an item's `uri` from `GET /v1/resources/{id}/collections`): the
cards whose link, or an alias's, it holds.
parameters.name: in_collection

parameters.description: `true`: job postings that may be done remotely; `false`: job postings that may not.
parameters.name: remote

parameters.description:
`true`: job postings past their `validThrough` (closed) are listed too; they are left out
otherwise.
parameters.name: closed

parameters.description:
Recipes with these ingredients: up to three, comma-separated, each of letters, digits,
spaces and hyphens. Each must match a whole word (or words) of an ingredient's name as the
recipe's card records it, without amounts (`flour` matches "all-purpose flour").
parameters.name: ingredient

parameters.description:
A list view with one row per group: the matching member with the most references, as its
own card; links in no group stay rows of their own. Not with `cluster`.
parameters.name: collapse

501.description: wot_2 asked of an instance whose Nexus serves no reach set
